data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows avatars with fallback to images, initials or custom text.
data.what_it_does: The Avatar widget picks the best available source among social image providers, network or asset images, and text (name initials or custom value). It falls back automatically if a source fails and can cache remote images.
use_when: You need an avatar that can try multiple image sources and fall back to initials.
You want built‑in caching for remote avatar images.
You require easy shape and style customization for avatars.
avoid_when: You only need a simple image widget without fallback logic.
You need support for social platforms not listed (e.g., Twitter).
You require advanced image editing or transformations.
strengths: Automatic priority & fallback among many sources
weaknesses: Limited to the provided social sources
No support for custom network error handling beyond fallback
No code‑generation or advanced image processing features

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides robust caching for network images without the extra avatar fallback logic.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers placeholder and error widget handling for images, useful if you only need simple fallback.
